chapter: Looking back, big bands and sidemen
title: The First Herd trumpet section: Pete Candoli, Conrad Gozzo
summary: Pete Candoli and Berman were in the section, with lead trumpeter Conrad Gozzo, who had been with Claude Thornhill and in the Navy with Artie Shaw's band.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: He was one of the highlights, I think, of that band. Pete Condoli was in that band, with Sonny at the same time. And later Conte, a couple of years later. And, of course, the lead trumpet player was very good. From Connecticut. Turn it off for a second and I'll try to come up with it.

Yeah, very early in the war, he was the lead trumpet player with Claude Thornhill's band which was a very musical and very beautiful band. And then I think during part of that war period, I believe he was with the Artie Shaw band, in the Navy. Then when he got out, he joined me. Oh, God -- Conrad Gazzo.
And this was one of the great trumpet -- I think each individual was a complete individual and made a fantastic section.
